top3: Demo seed and the Setup Wizard import leave search_index.listing_type empty, so type tabs/filters show 0 results on a freshly seeded Free site (hard fail, fixed by `wp listora reindex`).
Failed REST writes: favourite toggle fails silently (every other write shows an error); helpful vote has no live count and loses voted state on reload.
Free-mode wording and policy: 'Feature for 0 credit' lets any owner self-feature for free, renewal modal shows credit balance; claims approve/reject is one click with no confirm or reason.

failures.triage_note: HARD. Demo seed leaves listora_search_index.listing_type empty. Reproduced on two paths: `wp listora demo seed --pack=... --reindex` (all 56 seeded rows) AND the Setup Wizard background import (8 event listings, after the AS queue was run). The term is assigned (wp_get_object_terms returns it) but the index row has listing_type=''. `wp listora reindex` or a plain index_listing() call fills it, so the finalize/reindex step runs before types are written. Result: type tabs and ?listora_type= / REST type= return 0 for every seeded type, Showing 0 results, while the unfiltered directory shows all listings. Walker ran `wp listora reindex` once to continue; seeded state is therefore now indexed correctly.
failures.expected: After a demo seed or wizard import, /listings/?listora_type=restaurant lists the restaurants and type=event returns every event; search_index.listing_type equals the type term.
failures.actual: type=restaurant/hotel/classified/place all 0 results on the seeded site; after the wizard event import `type=event` returned 1 of 9 events (8 imported rows had listing_type='').

failures.triage_note: Failed REST write is swallowed. With POST /listora/v1/favorites aborted, the heart/Save button silently stays unsaved: no toast, no inline message, no aria-live text. Every other write walked (submit, review, claim, lead, feature, renew, listing update) shows 'Could not get a valid response from the server.'; favourites is the odd one out. It does not pretend success, but the member gets no signal.
failures.expected: A visible error (same wording as the other forms) when the save request fails.
failures.actual: Button reverts to Save with no message on detail page and on directory card hearts.

failures.triage_note: Helpful vote is stored (listora_review_votes row, helpful_count 1) but the button shows no live increment (label stays 'Helpful'); count '(N)' only appears after a reload, and after reload the voter's own vote is not shown as voted (button enabled again). Runbook row asks for N to increment on click.
failures.expected: Helpful (N) increments on click and the voted state survives reload.
failures.actual: Label unchanged after click, is-voted class lost on reload; helpful count visible only after reload.

failures.triage_note: Approve and Reject on Listora > Claims act on one click with no confirmation, and Reject has no field for a reason. Approve moves post_author to the claimant (irreversible from the UI). The rejection email therefore always reads 'Notes from admin: No additional details provided.' although the runbook says the claimant is emailed the rejection reason. Details drawer is read-only (Close only).
failures.expected: Confirmation for ownership transfer and an optional reason captured on reject, carried into the email.
failures.actual: Immediate state change; email body: 'No additional details provided.'

failures.triage_note: HTML entity in an email subject: with a site named 'Harbor & Pine' the listing_verify_email subject is delivered as 'Verify your email to publish your listing on Harbor & Pine' (Mailpit raw Subject). Other templates have no site name in the subject so they are unaffected. Sent via `wp listora test-email listing_verify_email`; 17 other templates sent cleanly.

Free site with no credit system, purchase path or gateway still shows credit chrome. (a) Owner's listing page shows a primary button 'Feature for 0 credit · 30 days' (singular 'credit' for 0 because of max(1,cost) in the plural logic); clicking it features the listing for free with no check, and Featured sorts first in the directory, so any member can pin their own listing to the top. (b) Renewal modal shows 'Cost Free' next to 'Your balance 0 credits'. Policy question for the owner: is zero-cost self-feature intended on Free? At minimum the copy should not mention credits when cost is 0 and no credit path exists.
failures.expected: Either hide Feature/credit wording when featured cost is 0 and there is no credit path, or label it 'Feature this listing' with an owner-set policy.
failures.actual: 'Feature for 0 credit · 30 days' button works for every owner; renewal modal shows credit balance.
